description:
Port-map §2. One `OctoPi.Coder.FileMutex.Worker` GenServer per
absolute path, started lazily via DynamicSupervisor, looked up
through `Registry.via_tuple({:file_mutex, path})`.

API:
- FileMutex.with_lock(path, fun) — acquires, runs fun, releases
- Reads + writes both serialize through the same lock (simplest
  semantics; upstream does too per file-mutation-queue.ts)

Workers terminate when idle (after a short timeout, e.g. 5s) so
we don't pile up GenServers for every file ever touched.

TDD:
- Two tasks writing the same file → serialized (assert order via
  test process messages).
- Different paths → concurrent (no serialization).
- Worker self-terminates after idle timeout.
- Lock survives an exception in the locked fun (ref released).

Depends on .1.
title: File mutex Registry (per-path GenServer locks)
